{{Top|leg}}
'''Lightweight armor''' was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] favored by [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]. Constructed from two [[Body glove/Legends|body glove]] sections of camouflage cloth, the armor also featured a helmet with [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] and extended filter which lasted up to six [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. The helmet visor had fitted [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]], and the armor had a [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] with multiple pouches and an integrated [[Multipack]].
